Expertise in Custom Medical Cable Assemblies and Plastic Components
#

Cambus Corporation has been a trusted provider of engineering and manufacturing services for custom medical cable assemblies and plastic components since 1997. Our management team brings over 30 years of experience in engineering and international trade, establishing a strong foundation within the industry.
